label: Something Precious and Always Present: B

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You scared me half to death!
Roam, who is standing far away from us, tosses the storage device toward us.
Anis and Neon both scramble to catch it, and end up slamming into each other.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You idiot! Why would you throw something this valuable?!
The section of the floor underneath Roam starts to split apart.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Stay still. Don't move. I'll come to you.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Don't budge, you hear?! This is the top floor. If you fall, it'll be bad news.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Leave it to EVE. If any of us head out, the floor is guaranteed to collapse.
The cracks in the floor widen.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I am fine. I am a robot.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: If Roam is broken, Roam can be fix...
The floor collapses, taking Roam along with it.
Without any hesitation, EVE jumps after Roam.
EVE dives into the hole Roam fell through.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Is that your main function? Gathering artifacts?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Affirmative. That is what I must do.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I do remember it is my duty.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Roam is making a second Ark.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: My mom can't hear very well, so if you have something to say, you need to shout it loudly.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Even if it is not important?

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: Yeah, so that she can hear.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: It might seem like you're overdoing it, but trust me, you won't be.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: And besides, everything you have to say is important.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: You're the hardest-working person in this house, and in our family.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Everyone always laughed when Roam broke a plate.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: When Roam had to shout loudly.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: This is the opposite direction of the Ark.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: We must go to the Ark.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: You can't get into the Ark without a winning ticket.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why do you need a winning ticket?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: If there is not enough space in the Ark, I can build one.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: All right then, let's do it.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: Let's build a second Ark, one of our own!

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why are you collecting all of these random objects?

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: These aren't random objects. They're artifacts.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: If we want to build a proper Ark, don't you think we'll need these?

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: If we want to make an Ark, we need artifacts. If either of us comes across anything that seems useful, we should take it.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why are you burying Mother in the ground?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: If you do that, she can't move. Why bury her?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: When the second Ark is complete,

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: will there be a family again?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Will be it lively? Hehe haha, like that?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Okay, then Roam will work hard to make a second Ark.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Family is something precious, something that's always there.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: You have to finish the second Ark,

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: so that people who have nowhere to go can stay there.

lines.speaker: girlvoice
lines.text: You have to make a place where people can laugh and be lively.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Why aren't you talking to Roam?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: is a place where people who have nowhere to go can stay. A lively place full of laughter.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: and it will become a happy place.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: Thank goodness. You took a new nasty bump during your fall and wouldn't wake up. I was getting worried.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Roam needs to make a second Ark.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: They are no longer here. They won't come back.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Still, Roam will make the second Ark.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: I want their wish to come true.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: But if my family is no longer here,

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: is it meaningless, what Roam is doing?

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: We must carry on the memory of those who left before us. In doing that, we prove that their lives had meaning.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: It helps us to remember that they helped forge us into the person we are today.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: When we remember them, we honor their memory.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: To say to the world that they were here once.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Roam will remember EVE as well.

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: These memories that we both hold dear to us... I hope they live on.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What's your status, both of you?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That was crazy. Holding onto Roam and leaping down by hopscotching across bits of debris.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I didn't know humans were capable of such a thing.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Whoa, you mean you could do something like that too, Master?

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Roam is safe. The storage device is intact as well.

lines.speaker: roam
lines.text: Now we just need to transfer the data and it's done?
Yeah. That's step one out of the way, and it was a big one.
